overall_notes: The paper focuses on developing GPTfluence, a method for analyzing training data influence on GPT models. It evaluates NLG tasks (translation, summarization, structured-to-text) using automatic metrics (BLEU/ROUGE) but does not use LLMs as judges or conduct human evaluations. The extraction quality was generally good with minor normalization needed.
